# COEUS PROPS & PARLAY REPORT — WEEK 4 (10/04/2026 SLATE)

**REAL DATA COVERAGE CHECK:** All five stat families (Passing Yards, Rushing Yards, Receiving Yards, Receptions, Anytime TD) are LIVE across all 4 games on this slate — no stale or unavailable families this week. No picks were withheld for data-availability reasons; several picks below *were* withheld because a specific player had no real FanDuel market at all (flagged individually where relevant).

**REAL DATA ANOMALIES FLAGGED (not used as picks):**
- NYJ @ CHI: Chicago's actual probable starters (Caleb Williams / Case Keenum) have **no FanDuel passing-yards market at all** — only 3rd-string Tyson Bagent (14.5) is posted. Not picked; Bagent is not a realistic snap-share play.
- NYJ @ CHI: **Breece Hall** — this week's one formal Threat (Standard/Triple, receiving yards) — has **no FanDuel prop market of any kind** in this game's real data. Flagged plainly rather than skipped silently.
- DAL @ HOU: The real feed lists **"Drake Maye" (passing/rushing)** and **"Rhamondre Stevenson" (receptions)** inside this game's player props. Neither player is on the Dallas or Houston roster in the evidence package (both are Patriots players) — this is a real upstream data mismatch, not a legitimate DAL/HOU market. Excluded entirely from every section below.
- ARI @ NYG: **Trey McBride** — the single strongest Threat on the whole slate (Standard/Triple, receiving) — has **no FanDuel market anywhere in this game** (no passing/rushing N-A, no receiving yards, no receptions line or alt). Flagged plainly; no pick possible.

## 1. COEUS PROP BREAKDOWN

### NYJ @ CHI (3 picks)

- **Geno Smith** (NYJ) — Passing Yards, Over 227.5, **-114**. Smith's 261.0 pass yds/gm ranks 10th among QBs; Chicago allows 219.0 ypg (13th) — a tougher-than-his-average matchup on paper, but his mid-tier-opponent game this season (Week 2 vs. GB, a near-identical defensive caliber) produced 247 yards, clearing this number. *Confidence: MEDIUM.*
- **Braelon Allen** (NYJ) — Rushing Yards, Under 56.5, **-114**. Allen's season rate is just 20.3 rush yds/gm (NYJ's clear RB2, 22.4% rush share) against a Chicago run defense that ranks a middling 17th vs. backs (95.3 yds/gm allowed) — nowhere close to lifting him to nearly triple his own average. (Real alt ladder for this market is Over-only — no Under-side alt exists for comparison.) *Confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH.*
- **Isaiah Davis** (NYJ) — Rushing Yards, Under 21.5, **-114**. Davis has 0.0 rushing yards on 0 real carries across his only two games played (0.0% rush share, buried at RB4), regardless of Chicago's team-wide run defense rank (21st, 117.0 yds/gm allowed) — this is a usage gap, not a matchup read. *Confidence: HIGH.*

### JAX @ CIN (3 picks)

- **Trevor Lawrence** (JAX) — Passing Yards, Under 263.5, **-114**. Lawrence's season rate is 205.3 ypg (23rd) with a season-high of just 245 yards in any single game — this line sits above everything he's actually done this year, even against Cincinnati's bottom-tier pass defense (287.0 ypg allowed, 29th), given JAX's own league-lowest passing volume (27.0 att/gm, 29th). *Confidence: MEDIUM.*
- **Bhayshul Tuten** (JAX) — Rushing Yards, Under 53.5, **-114**. Tuten's 68.0 rush yds/gm ranks 11th among backs, but Cincinnati's run defense ranks a stout 8th against backs specifically (68.3 yds/gm allowed) — the toughest run funnel he's faced all season, with no track record yet against this caliber. *Confidence: MEDIUM.*
- **Brian Thomas Jr.** (JAX) — Receiving Yards, Under 26.5, **-114**. Thomas's season average (29.3 rec yds/gm) barely clears this line, but it's propped up by two early-season games before his role collapsed — his most recent outing was just 8 yards on a 42% snap share as Parker Washington (30.7% target share) has fully overtaken him, even against a mid-tier Cincinnati WR defense (140.3 ypg allowed, 14th). *Confidence: MEDIUM.*

### DAL @ HOU (3 picks)

- **CeeDee Lamb** (DAL) — Receiving Yards, Over 76.5, **-114**. Lamb's 103.0 rec yds/gm ranks 4th in the league — the exact Standard/Triple Threat convergence fired this week — against a Houston defense allowing 176.3 rec yds/gm to WRs (27th); his own bottom-tier-matchup split (132.5 ypg, n=2) backs it further. The 90+ alt (+146) offers more value while still sitting below that tier average. *Confidence: HIGH.*
- **C.J. Stroud** (HOU) — Passing Yards, Under 244.5, **-114**. Stroud's 264.7 ypg average (8th) was built entirely against bottom-tier pass defenses (28th/29th/31st) — his first real test (Dallas, 9th in pass yards allowed) — and his own per-game outputs have swung wildly (167–353) independent of opponent quality, including a 167-yard dud against the league's 31st-ranked defense. *Confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH.*
- **Javonte Williams** (DAL) — Rushing Yards, Under 59.5, **-114**. Williams' 56.3 rush yds/gm (21st) already sits below this line, and Houston's run defense ranks a real 9th against backs (77.0 ypg allowed) — his only previous game against a top-tier run defense this season (Washington, 3rd) produced just 30.0 yards. *Confidence: LOW-MEDIUM (n=1 in the relevant tier).*

### ARI @ NYG (3 picks)

- **Michael Wilson** (ARI) — Receptions, Over 5+ (alt), **-182**. Wilson's 6.0 rec/gm ranks 8th among WRs — the exact Standard/Double Threat convergence this week — against a Giants defense allowing 12.3 catches/gm to WRs (25th, generous). *Confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH.*
- **Isaiah Likely** (NYG) — Receptions, Over 5+ (alt), **+128**. Likely's 5.0 rec/gm ranks 4th among TEs (the category behind his Standard/Triple Threat, built on receiving yards specifically), though Arizona's TE defense itself is only mid-pack in receptions allowed (5.3/gm, 17th) — his 40% red-zone target share is the real floor here. Recent trend (8→5→2 catches) is a real complicating factor. *Confidence: MEDIUM.*
- **Cam Skattebo** (NYG) — Receiving Yards, Under 17.5, **-114**. Skattebo's 19.7 rec yds/gm (16th among backs) sits just above this line, but Arizona ranks 4th in the league at limiting RB receiving production (17.0 yds/gm allowed) — directly below his own season rate. *Confidence: MEDIUM.*

- **QB:** C.J. Stroud (HOU) — Under 244.5 Passing Yards, **-114**. (Same reasoning as above.)
- **RB:** Braelon Allen (NYJ) — Under 56.5 Rushing Yards, **-114**. (Same reasoning as above.)
- **WR:** CeeDee Lamb (DAL) — Over 76.5 Receiving Yards, **-114**. (Same reasoning as above.)
- **TE:** Isaiah Likely (NYG) — Over 5+ Receptions (alt), **+128**. (Same reasoning as above.)
